name: canon-recall
description: LIVE: this suite asks the production store, not the fixture corpus (no throwaway database). Forty-five concepts — the twenty-five of the Canon (haskell-kb/notes/concepts) and the twenty of the Theory (theory-kb/notes/category-theory) — each asked twice: in English, and in Spanish the way the owner asks. The concept's own note must show up in the top 5; recall@1 and MRR say how often it comes FIRST. Born 26/11 with the English-corpus law: a Spanish question reaches the store only through its English restatement, so the Spanish half measures the input boundary as much as the store, and the English half measures whether a curated note outranks the fragments of the manuals it cites. Before that law (26/11, store as it stood): the Spanish monad question ranked the Canon's note tenth of ten.
